text_block_list.text:
—After the race, on my way back to the 
waiting room, I ran into a reporter.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your time. I'm Otonashi 
Etsuko from Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
… I watched the race. First of all, thank 
you very much for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Although she did not take first place, I 
think her unique personality came out in 
this race.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
… Well, trainer. How are you planning to 
adjust next race?
choice_data_list: I will seriously reflect on this result.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: I see, I see…

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Adjusts training based on result. 
Personally contacts chairwoman about 
deficiencies, doing everything for the 
sake of Uma Musume…

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
While accepting the results, they are 
looking to the future. That's the kind of 
trainer you'd expect at Tracen!
Looks like I handled that well!

I told <chrname> after the race that the interview 
had been a success and thanked her for her 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I see. I am a little disappointed 
because I was expecting to hear something 
more concrete after this result.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your comment. … I hope you 
win the next race!

This time, it didn't seem like I was able 
to sway the reporters much…

… Setting aside the coverage, I went to 
cheer up <chrname> after the race.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
How… Glorious! You're the quintessential 
Tracen Academy trainer!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Only believe in and develop her unique 
traits! So you mean, yes!? I understand! 
All that's missing is strategy and 
experience!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you're planning an all-nighter to 
come up with a hundred strategies!? Of 
course! It's to make sure your Uma wins!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Haa… What a passionate relationship of 
trust…! I'm deeply impressed…!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Our next feature is set! Quick… I need to 
hurry and talk to the editor-in-chief…!

… Looks like things were a little 
embellished, but at least it was taken 
well (?).

I tended to <chrname> after the race and told her 
about the interview.
